name: errance
description: Public transport worldwide powered by Transitous: journeys, departures, real time and maps

interface.longDescription:
Errance helps you get around by public transport, anywhere Transitous has open data. Plan a journey between two places and compare itineraries on a map, with walking, transfers and real-time delays. See the next departures from any stop, follow a trip stop by stop, and explore the lines and stops around a place. Find shared bikes, scooters and cars nearby, and see how far you can travel in a given time.

Errance uses the open GTFS, GTFS-RT and GBFS feeds aggregated by Transitous. The coverage and the real time depend on the data published for each region. No account is needed.
capabilities: Show the next departures of a stop
Follow a trip stop by stop
Explore the lines and stops of an area
Find shared bikes, scooters and cars
Show how far you can travel in a given time
defaultPrompt: How do I get from Gare de Lyon to Montmartre by public transport?
Where can I go within 30 minutes from Amsterdam Centraal?
